content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have experience programming traditional PLCs and have often leveraged the scan sequence to optimize my work. My current question is: what is the execution order when [product_name] processes FBD code? I tested a sample by converting ladder to FBD and then back to ladder, noticing that the ladder rung sequence changed. [user_name]

I'm not sure about the exact order in which blocks are processed during conversions between LAD and FBD, as such specifics might only be known to the developers of [product_name] software. From what I know, in [product_name], programs seem to run according to the order of block numbers.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to understand how [product_name] software determines execution order for automation programs, especially when switching between ladder diagram and FBD code. There is confusion because the software may change the sequence of logic elements during the conversion process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for clear and reliable information about how [product_name] maintains execution order across different programming formats, as well as improved documentation on processing logic within the software.
